basic_info.description: Experience bright, modern living in this stylish townhome at The Midtown, a boutique elevator building built in 2004. 1452 Bush Street No. 17 is a quiet, 2 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom condominium offering a spacious, house-like floor plan across two levels. The main level features an expansive, light-filled living room with a sunny walk-out balcony with downtown views  perfect for your morning coffee or evening glass of wine. The open concept, and recently updated kitchen, with attached dining area, are ideal for entertaining. A convenient powder room completes the main level of this charming home. Tucked away upstairs for maximum privacy, you'll find two spacious bedrooms, each with ensuite bathrooms. The south-facing primary bedroom boasts large, sunny windows and a built-in window seat. This modern home is complete with beautiful, brand-new hardwood floors, in-unit laundry, deeded independent garage parking, with EV charger, and elevator access directly to your floor. Located in a prime area with a 99 Walk Score, you're just steps away from Whole Foods, as well as the shops, restaurants, and cafes of Upper Polk and Pacific Heighs. Public transportation and freeway access are also conveniently close, making this an ideal urban retreat.
